rules.statement: An action to recover an alleged balance of the consideration for a sale of immovable property, where the deed does not recite that the full consideration has been paid and there is no statement in the attestation from which any promise or undertaking on the part of the vendor can be gathered, is prescribed in three years.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where in a deed of sale there is a recital that the full consideration has been paid and there is no statement in the attestation from which any promise or undertaking on the part of the vendor can be gathered, an action brought to recover an alleged balance of the consideration is prescribed in three years."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Prescription Ordinance (Cap. 55)-Sale of immovable property-Claim to recover balance purchase money-Sections 6 and 7.
